title: The Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act, 1975.
full_text: The Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act, 1975. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197544 Act Number: 44 Enactment Date: 1975-09-16 Act Year: 1975 Short Title: The Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act, 1975. Long Title: An Act to make better provision for trees in urban areas in the State by regulating felling of trees and providing for planting of adequate number of new trees in those areas.
